area: the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue, at the Dollar Tree
disposition: two suspects fled on foot; no arrests reported
summary: Officers were sent to a robbery in progress at the Dollar Tree on Mount Vernon Avenue in which a machete was used. Two suspects were last seen on foot heading toward the fast-food lot next door, and units were working the area.

area: southbound Interstate 5 north of the rest area
summary: A crash on southbound Interstate 5 north of the rest area left two people ejected from a vehicle. Traffic was held while crews worked the scene, and one patient was moved by air with the other taken by ground.

A caller reported that her husband and four of his friends had gone dirt biking in the area and none of them had returned or answered their phones. Crews were sent to the Lancer Drive area for a possible search and rescue.

disposition: rollover; a second reported vehicle not found
summary: A vehicle rolled over on northbound Rosedale Highway just north of Jenkins Road. Crews checked the area, and a reported black or blue sedan on the right shoulder could not be located.
Wasco police handled a crash in which the driver tried to flee and was detained. There were no people pinned, and the driver complained of generalized pain.
Firefighters were sent to a house fire in the county. Crews reported several places inside showing heat but no hazard to anyone, and units were released from the call.
Officers were sent to Panama Lane and Pebble Point for a vehicle against a pedestrian, with a person reported in the roadway on the southbound side.
A woman called 911 to report that she had been strangled and then disconnected. Officers were sent to Yuma Way to check on her.

area: the Walmart on North Chester Avenue
summary: Officers were sent to the Walmart on North Chester Avenue after a report of a person with a firearm. A man was reported in a black Kia with a juvenile female in the vehicle.

disposition: second party reported armed; deputies responded
summary: A caller said a neighbor came to her door saying his brother was trying to kill him. Deputies were sent to the 12900 block of Poppy Lane, where the other man was reported to have a firearm.

area: Interstate 5 just north of Stockdale Highway
summary: Crews were sent to a vehicle rollover on Interstate 5 just north of Stockdale Highway.

area: westbound Highway 58 just west of Highway 184
summary: A wrong-way driver was reported going eastbound in the westbound lanes of Highway 58 just west of Highway 184, with hazard lights on and running in the fast lane.

area: the 4300 block of el Sereno Drive
disposition: just occurred; vehicle entered as stolen
summary: A green 1995 Toyota pickup was reported taken from the 4300 block of el Sereno Drive just before the call came in.

disposition: car pulled to the right shoulder
summary: A tire thrown from a semi struck a car on southbound Interstate 5 south of Grapevine. The driver pulled to the right shoulder and reported no one hurt.
Fire and police were sent to an apartment on Bernard Street for a baby left unattended who was reported to be covered in nail glue.

disposition: multiple spots burning; dozers and a helicopter assigned
summary: A single call reported multiple spots with active flames north of an earlier fire. Patrols, two dozers, a water tender and a helicopter were assigned.

area: the 4300 block of California Spring Drive
summary: A caller reported two women fighting, with one dragging the other into a residence. Units were sent to the 4300 block of California Spring Drive.
A cell caller reported a prowler on South Chester Avenue. The subject, described as a bald man in a hooded sweater, was reported walking west on 23rd Street on foot.
A campfire at a homeless camp was reported to be spreading into grass, and crews were sent to put it out.
A man was reported not breathing and possibly overdosing in a vehicle in a Wingstop parking lot, and medics were sent to the scene.

area: the 3400 block of Mall View Road
summary: Officers were sent to the 3400 block of Mall View Road for a theft in progress, reported as five juveniles loading Nerf guns into suitcases.

disposition: call holding; a criminal protective order was on file
summary: Deputies were sent to the 1300 block of Princeton Avenue for a domestic disturbance, with a criminal protective order listing the caller as a protected party.

disposition: single occupant out and not injured
summary: A vehicle rolled over on southbound Interstate 5. The single occupant was out of the vehicle, conscious and breathing, and reported no injuries.
An engine was sent to the 12300 block of Rodeo Avenue for a seizure.

area: the 5800 block of Winter Ridge Drive
summary: Medics were sent to the 5800 block of Winter Ridge Drive for a person having difficulty breathing.
Man on bicycle found unconscious, bleeding at Manchester Lane.
Vehicle strikes pedestrian on Main Avenue.
Pedestrian struck by vehicle on Beechwood Way.
Person overdosing receives CPR near Bakersfield.
Vehicle strikes pedestrian at Panama and Pebble Point.
Cardiac arrest call on Belvedere Avenue.
Traumatic injury at Glenwood Dr with upset family present.
